Definition upRen_tm_tm   (xi : ( fin ) -> fin) : ( fin ) -> fin :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_tm   (xitm : ( fin ) -> fin) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => (var_tm ) (xitm s)
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((ren_tm xitm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)

    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s2) ((ren_tm xitm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat

    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)

Definition up_tm_tm   (sigma : ( fin ) -> tm ) : ( fin ) -> tm  :=
  (scons) ((var_tm ) (var_zero)) ((funcomp) (ren_tm (shift)) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_tm   (sigmatm : ( fin ) -> tm ) (s : tm ) : tm  :=

    | var_tm  s => sigmatm s
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s2) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

item.text: Conversion can ignore an argument at a particular lattice level. I’ll track which parts of a term are visible at each level and use that to justify conversion in the model.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('Task.v')
s=p.read_text()
pos=s.index('Theorem consistency')
p.write_text(s[:pos]+'''Local Open Scope lattice_scope.
Local Open Scope subst_scope.
Local Notation \"a ≤ₗ b\" := (a ⊆ b) (at level 70).

Local Lemma level_refl k : k ≤ₗ k.
Proof. apply meet_idempotent. Qed.
Local Lemma level_trans j k l : j ≤ₗ k -> k ≤ₗ l -> j ≤ₗ l.
Proof.
  intros H K. unfold subseteq in *.
  change (meet j l = j).
  rewrite <- H at 1. now rewrite meet_associative, K.
Qed.

Local Definition visible j k := T_eqb (meet j k) j.
Local Lemma visibleP j k : reflect (j ≤ₗ k) (visible j k).
Proof. apply T_eqdec. Qed.

Local Hint Constructors Par rtc : core.

(* Substitution and renaming are used both before and after taking a view. *)
Local Lemma ren_ext r q a :
  (forall i, r i = q i) -> ren_tm r a = ren_tm q a.
Proof.
  revert r q; induction a; intros r q H; simpl; f_equal;
    eauto; firstorder.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_ext s q a :
  (forall i, s i = q i) -> a[s] = a[q].
Proof.
  revert s q; induction a; intros s q H; simpl; f_equal; eauto;
    (eapply IHa || eapply IHa2); intros [|i]; simpl; auto;
    (f_equal; auto; destruct i; simpl; now rewrite ?H).
Qed.
Local Lemma ren_comp r q a :
  (a⟨r⟩)⟨q⟩ = a⟨r >> q⟩.
Proof.
  revert r q; induction a; intros r q; simpl; f_equal; eauto;
    rewrite ?IHa, ?IHa2;
    apply ren_ext; intros [|[|i]]; reflexivity.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_ren r s a :
  (a⟨r⟩)[s] = a[r >> s].
Proof.
  revert r s; induction a; intros r s; simpl; f_equal; eauto;
    rewrite ?IHa, ?IHa2;
    apply sub_ext; intros [|[|i]]; reflexivity.
Qed.
Local Lemma ren_sub r s a :
  (a[s])⟨r⟩ = a[s >> ren_tm r].
Proof.
  revert r s; induction a; intros r s; simpl; f_equal; eauto;
    rewrite ?IHa, ?IHa2;
    apply sub_ext; intros [|[|i]]; simpl;
    rewrite ?ren_comp; apply ren_ext || reflexivity; reflexivity.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_comp s q a :
  (a[s])[q] = a[s >> subst_tm q].
Proof.
  revert s q; induction a; intros s q; simpl; f_equal; eauto;
    rewrite ?IHa, ?IHa2;
    apply sub_ext; intros [|[|i]]; simpl;
    repeat rewrite ?sub_ren, ?ren_sub; reflexivity.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_ids a : a[var_tm] = a.
Proof.
  induction a; simpl; f_equal; auto;
    (etransitivity; [apply sub_ext | eassumption]);
    intros [|[|i]]; reflexivity.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_up1 (s : nat -> tm) a b :
  (a[up_tm_tm s])[b..] = a[b .: s].
Proof.
  rewrite sub_comp. apply sub_ext. intros [|i]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite sub_ren. apply sub_ids.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_up2 (s : nat -> tm) a b c :
  (a[up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm s)])[b .: c ..] = a[b .: c .: s].
Proof.
  rewrite sub_comp. apply sub_ext. intros [|[|i]]; simpl; auto.
  repeat rewrite sub_ren. apply sub_ids.
Qed.
Local Lemma sub_single (s : nat -> tm) a b :
  (a[b..])[s] = a[b[s] .: s].
Proof. rewrite sub_comp. apply sub_ext. now intros [|i]. Qed.
Local Lemma sub_double (s : nat -> tm) a b c :
  (a[b .: c ..])[s] = a[b[s] .: c[s] .: s].
Proof. rewrite sub_comp. apply sub_ext. now intros [|[|i]]. Qed.

Local Lemma par_refl a : a ⇒ a.
Proof. induction a; now constructor. Qed.

Local Lemma par_ren r a b : a ⇒ b -> a⟨r⟩ ⇒ b⟨r⟩.
Proof.
  intro H; revert r; induction H; intro r; simpl; eauto using Par;
    rewrite ?ren_sub;
    match goal with
    | |- Par _ (subst_tm ?s ?a) =>
      first
        [ eapply P_AppAbs with (a0 := a⟨upRen_tm_tm r⟩) in IHPar1
        | idtac ];
      let u := lazymatch goal with
        | H : forall r, Par _ (ren_tm r ?a) |- _ => constr:(a)
        end in idtac
    end.
Qed.
''' + s[pos:])

printf 'End consistency.\\n' >> /tmp/DcoiCheck.v
rocq compile -q -w -all -R theories DCOIOmega -R .rocq-deps/stdpp stdpp /tmp/DcoiCheck.v"

(* A view keeps the arguments that the observer can distinguish. *)
Local Fixpoint view (k : T) (a : tm) : tm :=
  match a with
  | var_tm i => var_tm i
  | tAbs j b => tAbs j (view k b)
  | tApp f j a => tApp (view k f) j (if visible j k then view k a else tRefl)
  | tPi j A B => tPi j (view k A) (view k B)
  | tUniv n => tUniv n
  | tVoid => tVoid
  | tAbsurd _ => tAbsurd tRefl
  | tEq j a b => tEq j (view k a) (view k b)
  | tJ j a b => tJ j (view k a) (view k b)
  | tRefl => tRefl
  | tSig j A B => tSig j (view k A) (view k B)
  | tPack j a b => tPack j (if visible j k then view k a else tRefl) (view k b)
  | tLet i j a b => tLet i j (view k a) (view k b)
  | tZero => tZero
  | tSuc n => tSuc (view k n)
  | tInd j a b n => tInd j (view k a) (view k b) (view k n)
  | tNat => tNat
  | tTT => tTT
  | tSeq j a b => tSeq j (view k a) (view k b)
  | tUnit => tUnit
  end.

Local Lemma view_ren k r a : view k (a⟨r⟩) = (view k a)⟨r⟩.
Proof.
  revert r; induction a; intros r; simpl;
    try destruct (visible t k); f_equal; auto.
Qed.
Local Lemma view_sub k s a : view k a[s] = (view k a)[s >> view k].
Proof.
  revert s; induction a; intros s; simpl;
    try destruct (visible t k); f_equal; auto;
    rewrite ?IHa ?IHa2;
    apply sub_ext; intros [|[|i]];
    cbv beta delta [up_tm_tm scons unscoped.funcomp axioms.funcomp] iota;
    cbn -[up_tm_tm]; now rewrite ?view_ren.
Qed.
Local Lemma view_down j k a : j ≤ₗ k -> view j (view k a) = view j a.
Proof.
  intros H; induction a; simpl; f_equal; auto;
    destruct (visibleP t j) as [Hj|Hj]; auto;
    destruct (visibleP t k); simpl; eauto using level_trans;
    exfalso; eauto using level_trans.
Qed.

Local Definition under k (P : nat -> Prop) j :=
  fun i => match i with 0 => j ≤ₗ k | S n => P n end.
Local Fixpoint good k (P : nat -> Prop) a : Prop :=
  match a with
  | var_tm i => P i
  | tAbs j a => good k (under k P j) a
  | tApp a _ b => good k P a /\\ good k P b
  | tPi j A B | tSig j A B => good k P A /\\ good k (under k P j) B
  | tEq j a b => j ≤ₗ k /\\ good k P a /\\ good k P b
  | tJ _ a b | tPack _ a b | tSeq _ a b => good k P a /\\ good k P b
  | tLet i j a b => good k P a /\\ good k (under k (under k P i) j) b
  | tInd j a b n => good k P a /\\ good k (under k (under k P j) j) b /\\ good k P n
  | tSuc a | tAbsurd a => good k P a
  | _ => True
  end.

Local Ltac split_hyps :=
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\\ _ |- _ => destruct H end.
Local Lemma good_ren k P Q r a :
  good k P a -> (forall i, P i -> Q (r i)) -> good k Q (a⟨r⟩).
Proof.
  revert P Q r; induction a; intros P Q r H R; simpl in *;
    split_hyps; repeat split; eauto;
    (eapply IHa || eapply IHa2); try eassumption;
    intros [|[|i]]; simpl; auto.

Qed.

Qed.

    split_hyps; f_equal; eauto;
    (eapply IHa || eapply IHa2); try eassumption;
    intros [|[|i]]; cbv beta delta [under up_tm_tm scons unscoped.funcomp axioms.funcomp] iota;
    intro Hi; now rewrite ?(R _ Hi).

  | _ :: Ξ, S i => allowed k Ξ i
  end.

Proof.

    + erewrite good_sub_agree.
      * eapply P_LetPack; eauto.
      * eapply good_par; eauto.
      * intros [|[|i]] Hi; simpl in *; tauto.
  - rewrite view_sub. simpl. eapply P_IndSuc; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma well_par k Ξ a b : a ⇒ b -> well k Ξ a -> well k Ξ b.
Proof. unfold well; eauto using view_par, good_par. Qed.
Local Lemma well_rtc k Ξ a b : a ⇒* b -> well k Ξ a -> well k Ξ b.
Proof. intros H K; induction H; eauto using well_par. Qed.
Local Lemma view_rtc k Ξ a b : a ⇒* b -> well k Ξ a -> view k a ⇒* view k b.

  end.

  joinable a b -> head_of a = Some h -> head_of b = Some h' -> h = h'.

Local Lemma observed_head k Ξ a b h h' :

(* Universe n is interpreted using the interpretations at indices below n.
   The predicates interpreting the domains of products are indices of Code. *)
Local Fixpoint numeral n :=
  match n with 0 => tZero | S n => tSuc (numeral n) end.

Local Definition product_member j (D : tm -> Prop) (C : tm -> tm -> Prop) f :=
  forall x, valid j x -> D x -> C x (tApp f j x).
Local Definition sum_member j (D : tm -> Prop) (C : tm -> tm -> Prop) p :=
  exists x y, joinable p (tPack j x y) /\\ valid j x /\\ D x /\\ C x y.
Local Definition eq_member j a b p :=
  joinable p tRefl /\\ observed j nil a b.
Local Definition nat_member a := exists n, joinable a (numeral n).

Local Inductive Code (n : nat) (U : nat -> tm -> Prop) : tm -> (tm -> Prop) -> Prop :=
| code_void A :
    joinable A tVoid -> Code n U A (fun _ => False)
| code_nat A :
    joinable A tNat -> Code n U A nat_member
| code_unit A :
    joinable A tUnit -> Code n U A (fun a => joinable a tTT)
| code_univ A i P :
    joinable A (tUniv i) -> i < n ->
    (forall a, P a <-> U i a) -> Code n U A P
| code_pi A j D C PD PC :
    joinable A (tPi j D C) ->
    Code n U D PD ->
    (forall x, valid j x -> PD x -> Code n U C[x..] (PC x)) ->
    Code n U A (product_member j PD PC)
| code_sig A j D C PD PC :
    joinable A (tSig j D C) ->
    Code n U D PD ->
    (forall x, valid j x -> PD x -> Code n U C[x..] (PC x)) ->
    Code n U A (sum_member j PD PC)
| code_eq A j a b :
    joinable A (tEq j a b) -> well j nil a -> well j nil b ->
    Code n U A (eq_member j a b).

Local Fixpoint universe n : nat -> tm -> Prop :=
  match n with
  | 0 => fun _ _ => False
  | S n => fun i a =>
      if Nat.eqb i n then exists P, Code n (universe n) a P
      else universe n i a
  end.
Local Definition interprets n := Code n (universe n).
Local Definition type_denotes A := exists n P, interprets n A P.
Local Definition realizes A a := exists n P, interprets n A P /\\ P a.

Local Lemma universe_spec n i a : i < n ->
  universe n i a <-> exists P, interprets i a P.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intro L; [lia|].
  simpl. destruct (Nat.eqb_spec i n) as [->|H]; [reflexivity|].
  apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_change_type n U A B P :
  Code n U A P -> joinable A B -> Code n U B P.
Proof.
  intros H J; destruct H;
    solve [eapply code_void; eauto using join_trans, join_sym
          |eapply code_nat; eauto using join_trans, join_sym
          |eapply code_unit; eauto using join_trans, join_sym
          |eapply code_univ; [eapply join_trans; [apply join_sym; exact J | eassumption]|eassumption..]
          |eapply code_pi; [eapply join_trans; [apply join_sym; exact J | eassumption]|eassumption..]
          |eapply code_sig; [eapply join_trans; [apply join_sym; exact J | eassumption]|eassumption..]
          |eapply code_eq; [eapply join_trans; [apply join_sym; exact J | eassumption]|eassumption..]].
Qed.

Local Lemma code_lift n A P :
  interprets n A P -> forall m, n <= m -> interprets m A P.
Proof.
  unfold interprets. intro H; induction H; intros m L;
    try solve [eapply code_void; eassumption
              |eapply code_nat; eassumption
              |eapply code_unit; eassumption
              |eapply code_eq; eassumption
              |eapply code_pi; eauto
              |eapply code_sig; eauto].
  eapply code_univ; [eassumption|lia|].
  intros x. rewrite H0 (universe_spec n i x) (universe_spec m i x); auto; lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_artifact_move n A P a b :
  interprets n A P -> joinable a b -> P a -> P b.
Proof.
  unfold interprets. intro H; induction H; intros x y J K; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct K as [v Kv]; exists v; eauto using join_trans, join_sym.
  - eauto using join_trans, join_sym.
  - assert (Lx : P x <-> exists Q, interprets i x Q).
    { rewrite H0. apply universe_spec; assumption. }
    assert (Ly : P y <-> exists Q, interprets i y Q).
    { rewrite H0. apply universe_spec; assumption. }
    apply Lx in K. destruct K as [Q Qx].
    apply Ly. exists Q. eapply code_change_type; eassumption.
  - intros v V Dv. eapply H1; try eassumption; [|apply K; assumption].
    eapply join_App; auto using join_refl.
  - destruct K as [v [w [Kv [L [M N]]]]].
    exists v,w; repeat split; auto. eauto using join_trans, join_sym.
  - split_hyps. split; auto. eauto using join_trans, join_sym.
Qed.

Local Lemma eq_endpoints k j a b a' b' :
  j ≤ₗ k ->
  well j nil a -> well j nil b -> well j nil a' -> well j nil b' ->
  observed k nil a a' -> observed k nil b b' ->
  (observed j nil a b <-> observed j nil a' b').
Proof.
  intros L Ha Hb Ha' Hb' K1 K2.
  pose proof (observed_down _ _ _ _ _ L Ha Ha' K1) as J1.
  pose proof (observed_down _ _ _ _ _ L Hb Hb' K2) as J2.
  pose proof (observed_direct _ _ _ _ Ha Ha' J1) as V1.
  pose proof (observed_direct _ _ _ _ Hb Hb' J2) as V2.
  split; intro E; apply observed_from_view; try assumption.
  - eapply join_trans; [apply join_sym; exact V1|].
    eapply join_trans; [eapply observed_direct; eassumption|exact V2].
  - eapply join_trans; [exact V1|].
    eapply join_trans; [eapply observed_direct; eassumption|apply join_sym; exact V2].
Qed.

(* Each type has the same members in any two interpretations related by a view. *)
Local Lemma code_agree n A P :
  interprets n A P ->
  forall m B Q k, interprets m B Q -> observed k nil A B ->
    forall x, P x <-> Q x.
Proof.
  unfold interprets. intro HA; induction HA; intros m B Q k HB O x; destruct HB;
    match goal with
    | V : observed _ nil ?a ?b, L : joinable ?a ?a', R : joinable ?b ?b' |- _ =>
        let W := fresh \"W\" in
        pose proof (observed_move _ _ _ _ _ _ L R V) as W;
        let E := fresh \"E\" in
        pose proof (observed_head _ _ _ _ _ _ W eq_refl eq_refl) as E;
        inversion E; subst; clear E
    end; try reflexivity.
  - rewrite H1 H4 (universe_spec n i0 x) (universe_spec m i0 x); auto.
  - apply observed_Pi in W. destruct W as [WD WC].
    unfold product_member. split; intros F a Va Da.
    + eapply (proj1 (H1 a Va _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)).
      * eapply (proj2 (IHHA _ _ _ _ HB WD a)); exact Da.
      * apply H3; assumption.
      * eapply observed_single; eassumption.
      * apply F; auto. eapply (proj2 (IHHA _ _ _ _ HB WD a)); exact Da.
    + eapply (proj2 (H1 a Va Da _ _ _ _ _ _ _)); try eassumption.
      * apply H3; auto. eapply (proj1 (IHHA _ _ _ _ HB WD a)); exact Da.
      * eapply observed_single; eassumption.
      * apply F; auto. eapply (proj1 (IHHA _ _ _ _ HB WD a)); exact Da.
  - apply observed_Sig in W. destruct W as [WD WC].
    unfold sum_member. split; intros [a [b [J [Va [Da Db]]]]].
    + assert (Da' : PD0 a) by (eapply (proj1 (IHHA _ _ _ _ HB WD a)); exact Da).
      exists a,b. repeat split; auto.

      * apply H3; assumption.
      * eapply observed_single; eassumption.
    + assert (Da' : PD a) by (eapply (proj2 (IHHA _ _ _ _ HB WD a)); exact Da).
      exists a,b. repeat split; auto.
      eapply (proj2 (H1 a Va Da' _ _ _ _ _ _ b)); try eassumption.
      * apply H3; assumption.
      * eapply observed_single; eassumption.
  - apply observed_Eq in W. destruct W as [L [WA WB]].
    unfold eq_member.
    rewrite (eq_endpoints _ _ _ _ _ _ L); auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma realizes_change A B a b :
  joinable A B -> joinable a b -> realizes A a -> realizes B b.
Proof.
  intros J K [n [P [H V]]]. exists n,P. split.
  - eapply code_change_type; eassumption.
  - eapply code_artifact_move; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma realizes_observed A B a k :
  realizes A a -> type_denotes B -> observed k nil A B -> realizes B a.
Proof.
  intros [n [P [HP Ha]]] [m [Q HQ]] O.
  exists m,Q. split; auto. eapply (proj1 (code_agree _ _ _ HP _ _ _ _ HQ O a)); exact Ha.
Qed.

s=s.replace('code_sig A j D C PD PC :', 'code_sig A j D C PD PC P :').replace('Code n U A (sum_member j PD PC)', '(forall x, P x <-> sum_member j PD PC x) -> Code n U A P')

Proof.
  intros H E; destruct H;
    first [eapply code_void | eapply code_nat | eapply code_unit | eapply code_univ |
           eapply code_pi | eapply code_sig | eapply code_eq];
    try eassumption;
    intros; rewrite E; eauto.
Qed.

'''+s[i:]

i=s.index('Local Lemma code_present'); j=s.index('Local Lemma code_lift',i)

  - eapply code_void; [eassumption|intros; rewrite E; auto].
  - eapply code_nat; [eassumption|intros; rewrite E; auto].
  - eapply code_unit; [eassumption|intros; rewrite E; auto].
  - eapply code_univ; [eassumption|eassumption|intros; rewrite E; auto].
  - eapply code_pi; [eassumption..|intros; rewrite E; auto].
  - eapply code_sig; [eassumption..|intros; rewrite E; auto].
  - eapply code_eq; [eassumption..|intros; rewrite E; auto].
Qed.

'''
s=s[:i]+cb+s[j:]
# Expose the standard member predicate in each non-universe case.
i=s.index('Local Lemma code_artifact_move'); j=s.index('Local Lemma eq_endpoints',i)

a=cb.index('  - assert (Lx'); b=cb.index('  - intros v',a)

    apply (universe_spec n i y H0). exists Q. eapply code_change_type; eassumption.
'''+cb[b:]
cb=cb.replace('  - contradiction.\\n','')
s=s[:i]+cb+s[j:]
# First rewrite each standard predicate, then compare the interpreted heads.
i=s.index('Local Lemma code_agree'); j=s.index('Local Lemma realizes_as',i)
cb=s[i:j]
cb=cb.replace('    end; try reflexivity.', '''    end;
    match goal with
    | E : forall a, ?P a <-> _, F : forall b, ?Q b <-> _ |- ?P ?x <-> ?Q ?x =>
        rewrite (E x) (F x)
    end; try reflexivity.''')
cb=cb.replace('rewrite H1 H4 (universe_spec','rewrite (universe_spec')
# Eq well-scope names now include the extra predicate equivalence in each group.
cb=cb.replace('W H0 H1 H3 H4','W H0 H1 H4 H5')
s=s[:i]+cb+s[j:]
s=s.replace('P = product_member j PA PB.', '(forall f, P f <-> product_member j PA PB f).')
s=s.replace('P = sum_member j PA PB.', '(forall p, P p <-> sum_member j PA PB p).')
s=s.replace(\"    + apply join_sub_same, join_sym; eassumption.\\nQed.\", \"    + apply join_sub_same, join_sym; eassumption.\\n  - assumption.\\nQed.\")
# Inversions for ground constructors must project the corresponding member predicate.
s=s.replace('  destruct K as [i [v [Hv J]]].', '''  match goal with E : forall x, P x <-> _ |- _ => apply E in K end.
  destruct K as [i [v [Hv J]]].''')
s=s.replace('  destruct K as [v [Hv J]].', '''  match goal with E : forall x, P x <-> _ |- _ => apply E in K end.
  destruct K as [v [Hv J]].''')
s=s.replace('  destruct K as [[v [Hv J]] O]. split.', '''  match goal with E : forall x, P x <-> _ |- _ => apply E in K end.
  destruct K as [[v [Hv J]] O]. split.''')
s=s.replace('[HB ->]]]]','[HB E]]]]').replace('  destruct V as [x [y [[z', '  apply E in V. destruct V as [x [y [[z')
s=s.replace('split; [apply code_nat, join_refl|]', 'split; [eapply code_nat; [apply join_refl|reflexivity]|]')
s=s.replace('split; [apply code_unit|]; apply join_refl.', 'split; [eapply code_unit; [apply join_refl|reflexivity]|apply join_refl].')
s=s.replace('apply code_eq; auto using join_refl.', 'eapply code_eq; try eassumption; [apply join_refl|reflexivity].')
s=s.replace('apply code_void, join_refl.', 'apply code_void; [apply join_refl|reflexivity].')
p.write_text(s)
